verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Highnote serves an llms.txt at docs.highnote.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Highnote also publishes markdown (.md) versions of pages such as the agentic-commerce solution page, which agents can read easily. Missing for 10: evidence of the full llms.txt contents and coverage (e.g., llms-full.txt or a link index across all docs), and documented agent-oriented doc guidance or independent hands-on use by an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.highnote.com/llms.txt # Highnote Documentation
Highnote is a card issuance, payment processing, and money movement platform-as-a-service.
